paragraphs.text: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified, even as also [it is] with you;
paragraphs.original: Τὸ λοιπὸν προσεύχεσθε, ἀδελφοί, περὶ ἡμῶν, ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ κυρίου τρέχῃ καὶ δοξάζηται καθὼς καὶ πρὸς ὑμᾶς,
paragraphs.translit: To loipon proseuchesthe, adelphoi, peri hēmōn, hina ho logos tou kyriou trechē kai doxazētai kathōs kai pros hymas,

paragraphs.text: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for all have not faith.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἵνα ῥυσθῶμεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἀτόπων καὶ πονηρῶν ἀνθρώπων, οὐ γὰρ πάντων ἡ πίστις.
paragraphs.translit: kai hina rhysthōmen apo tōn atopōn kai ponērōn anthrōpōn, ou gar pantōn hē pistis.

paragraphs.text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and guard you from the evil [one].
paragraphs.original: πιστὸς δέ ἐστιν ὁ κύριος, ὃς στηρίξει ὑμᾶς καὶ φυλάξει ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ.
paragraphs.translit: pistos de estin ho kyrios, hos stērixei hymas kai phylaxei apo tou ponērou.

paragraphs.text: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command.
paragraphs.original: πεποίθαμεν δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ἃ παραγγέλλομεν καὶ ποιεῖτε καὶ ποιήσετε.
paragraphs.translit: pepoithamen de en kyriō ephʼ hymas, hoti ha parangellomen kai poieite kai poiēsete.

paragraphs.text: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ κύριος κατευθύναι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας εἰς τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἰς τὴν ὑπομονὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ho de kyrios kateuthynai hymōn tas kardias eis tēn agapēn tou theou kai eis tēn hypomonēn tou Christou.

paragraphs.text: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which they received of us.
paragraphs.original: Παραγγέλλομεν δὲ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ στέλλεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ παντὸς ἀδελφοῦ ἀτάκτως περιπατοῦντος καὶ μὴ κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ἣν παρελάβοσαν παρʼ ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Parangellomen de hymin, adelphoi, en onomati tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou stellesthai hymas apo pantos adelphou ataktōs peripatountos kai mē kata tēn paradosin hēn parelabosan parʼ hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: For yourselves know how ye ought to imitate us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
paragraphs.original: αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε πῶς δεῖ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς, ὅτι οὐκ ἠτακτήσαμεν ἐν ὑμῖν
paragraphs.translit: autoi gar oidate pōs dei mimeisthai hēmas, hoti ouk ētaktēsamen en hymin

paragraphs.text: neither did we eat bread for nought at any man`s hand, but in labor and travail, working night and day, that we might not burden any of you:
paragraphs.original: οὐδὲ δωρεὰν ἄρτον ἐφάγομεν παρά τινος, ἀλλʼ ἐν κόπῳ καὶ μόχθῳ νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἐργαζόμενοι πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἐπιβαρῆσαί τινα ὑμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: oude dōrean arton ephagomen para tinos, allʼ en kopō kai mochthō nyktos kai hēmeras ergazomenoi pros to mē epibarēsai tina hymōn·

paragraphs.text: not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves and ensample unto you, that ye should imitate us.
paragraphs.original: οὐχ ὅτι οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν, ἀλλʼ ἵνα ἑαυτοὺς τύπον δῶμεν ὑμῖν εἰς τὸ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: ouch hoti ouk echomen exousian, allʼ hina heautous typon dōmen hymin eis to mimeisthai hēmas.

paragraphs.text: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, If any will not work, neither let him eat.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γὰρ ὅτε ἦμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, τοῦτο παρηγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν, ὅτι εἴ τις οὐ θέλει ἐργάζεσθαι μηδὲ ἐσθιέτω.
paragraphs.translit: kai gar hote ēmen pros hymas, touto parēngellomen hymin, hoti ei tis ou thelei ergazesthai mēde esthietō.

paragraphs.text: For we hear of some that walk among you disorderly, that work not at all, but are busybodies.
paragraphs.original: ἀκούομεν γάρ τινας περιπατοῦντας ἐν ὑμῖν ἀτάκτως, μηδὲν ἐργαζομένους ἀλλὰ περιεργαζομένους·
paragraphs.translit: akouomen gar tinas peripatountas en hymin ataktōs, mēden ergazomenous alla periergazomenous·

paragraphs.text: Now them that are such we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
paragraphs.original: τοῖς δὲ τοιούτοις παραγγέλλομεν καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν ἐν κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ ἵνα μετὰ ἡσυχίας ἐργαζόμενοι τὸν ἑαυτῶν ἄρτον ἐσθίωσιν.
paragraphs.translit: tois de toioutois parangellomen kai parakaloumen en kyriō Iēsou Christō hina meta hēsychias ergazomenoi ton heautōn arton esthiōsin.

paragraphs.text: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well-doing.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, μὴ ἐγκακήσητε καλοποιοῦντες.
paragraphs.translit: hymeis de, adelphoi, mē enkakēsēte kalopoiountes.

paragraphs.text: And if any man obeyeth not our word by this epistle, note that man, that ye have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
paragraphs.original: Εἰ δέ τις οὐχ ὑπακούει τῷ λόγῳ ἡμῶν διὰ τῆς ἐπιστολῆς, τοῦτον σημειοῦσθε, μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι αὐτῷ, ἵνα ἐντραπῇ·
paragraphs.translit: Ei de tis ouch hypakouei tō logō hēmōn dia tēs epistolēs, touton sēmeiousthe, mē synanamignysthai autō, hina entrapē·

paragraphs.text: And [yet] count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
paragraphs.original: καὶ μὴ ὡς ἐχθρὸν ἡγεῖσθε, ἀλλὰ νουθετεῖτε ὡς ἀδελφόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai mē hōs echthron hēgeisthe, alla noutheteite hōs adelphon.

paragraphs.text: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
paragraphs.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ κύριος τῆς εἰρήνης δῴη ὑμῖν τὴν εἰρήνην διὰ παντὸς ἐν παντὶ τρόπῳ. ὁ κύριος μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Autos de ho kyrios tēs eirēnēs dōē hymin tēn eirēnēn dia pantos en panti tropō. ho kyrios meta pantōn hymōn.

paragraphs.text: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
paragraphs.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου, ὅ ἐστιν σημεῖον ἐν πάσῃ ἐπιστολῇ· οὕτως γράφω.
paragraphs.translit: Ho aspasmos tē emē cheiri Paulou, ho estin sēmeion en pasē epistolē· houtōs graphō.

paragraphs.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
paragraphs.original: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hē charis tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou meta pantōn hymōn.
